rootCause.fixDescription: FR-5 requires the inactivity-alerts cron to fire every 30 minutes, not daily. The vercel.json regression set it back to '0 9 * * *'. Branch corrects the schedule to '*/30 * * * *', removes the duplicate inactivity-check cron entry, and adds a 288-line unit test that validates dedup, dry-run, and alert code paths without requiring the Next.js runtime.

vercel.json is a simple JSON config — no logic changes, no migrations
Unit test is new file — no conflict risk
Changing from daily to every-30-min cron could increase Vercel function invocations; acceptable per FR-5 spec

recommendation: shippable-needs-task-pr — the fix corrects a real regression (FR-5 requires 30-min cron, main currently fires daily). Branch is recent, low-risk, and already includes a unit test. Create a task + PR to QC and merge this branch. If the branch has drifted from current main, a rebase is likely clean given the only changed files are vercel.json and a new test file.
